name: disease

thresholds.note: fusion applies t_disease = 0.60, the RAP bound below which a result is uncertain. For disease-v2 the threshold was not re-selected on validation (fixed before training); 0.60 is kept.

training_data: PlantVillage maize train/val + Bangladesh field photos (RAW_Image, 4 classes), grouped split; data/processed/disease_v2/split_report.json
selection_note: Pre-set rules 2 and 3 failed; v2 was adopted as a documented deviation because it beats v1 on every overall measure on both test sets (see docs/disease_v2_rules.md, Decision).
